You should talk to some (or a lot) of homeowners to see who feels that way. Personally I've never met any who thinks of their home like it was a stock certificate.

To most people, but especially older people, their home is home. Where they built a life, saw kids born and raised and where that now-adult kids bedrooms still brings them memories.
